name: yak
description: The kernel Worker's npm dependencies, bundled by wrangler; node_modules is gitignored, so nothing here runs by hand — `deno task deploy:yak` and `deno task dev:yak` (and the probe) install through wrangler.ts before wrangler reads it. Exact pins only. This file is for npm alone. NO `version` field: give it one and deno links the package for real, then refuses every check with `Linking npm packages requires using a node_modules directory`, since the kernel's own imports resolve through the root import map instead. Deno is kept away from this file by the deno.json beside it, which is what makes this directory a workspace member — without it deno knew the member only by this package.json and printed `Linked package ignored because package.json was missing version field` on every `task` invocation (T-35343). wrangler warns about none of this.
